description.text: Training Levels:For students having mastered about 4500 words. Teaching Objectives:After they conclude one academic year's study and acquire the required credit points, they are supposed to have a vocabulary of 8000 words or so and vocabulary、discourse、rhetoric of the advanced phase. Training Hours:One academic year contains two terms, the first term will last for 20 weeks. and the second term will last for 20 weeks, 40 weeks in total. There are 12-18 teaching hours per week, altogether 480-720 teaching

duration.text: The Advanced Chinese Training Courses at Beijing Language and Culture University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3222 USD/per year ￥ 23200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Valid identity document of the applicant's emergency contact person For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc

requirements.text: The applicant should graduate from a senior high school, and be in the age bracket of 18-50
